topologyDecisions: Line 011 is stored as two complete independently ordered official patterns; both use closesLoop:false.
Line 042 is stored as two independently ordered official attraction-shuttle patterns; both use closesLoop:false.
No return direction is inferred by reversing another pattern and no last-to-first edge is created.
The shared Terra Mítica terminal BND 187 appears in both open directions without creating a synthetic cycle.
The Line 011 bracketed bus-station/service-shortening semantics remain a provenance review item rather than being silently flattened into additional patterns.
identityDecisions: Composite BND code is the stable identity key and maps to marina-baixa-stop-bnd-<number> / marina-baixa-place-bnd-<number>.
All accepted shared objects are copied exactly from prior Benidorm scenarios.
BND 184 and BND 182 remain distinct despite sharing the label Av. Eduardo Zaplana, s/n.
BND 185 and BND 189 remain distinct directional Terra Natura identities.
Every new StopNode receives a singleton StopPlace; proximity and equal names do not merge identities.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform or stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.
